name: Zhipuai Provider
description: Registers Zhipu AI (GLM) as a chat provider for the Drupal AI module, with the API key held in a Key entity.
project_description: Zhipuai Provider integrates Zhipu AI's GLM Large Language Models with Drupal's AI module. Once the module is enabled and a Key entity holding your Zhipuai API key is selected on the provider settings page, Zhipu's chat models (glm-4.5, glm-4.5-air, glm-4.5-x, glm-4.5-airx, glm-4.5-flash) become available anywhere the AI module offers a provider choice. Note: because the glm-4.5 response lacks the 'object' property that openai-php requires, this module ships its own small Guzzle-based client rather than using openai-php. Get an API key at https://bigmodel.cn/usercenter/proj-mgmt/apikeys .
